observations.subject: isSelf
observations.claim: The visible branch sets isSelf from targetUser.ID == currentUser.ID; self requests skip requireSpaceAdministrator, while non-self requests must pass it.

observations.subject: DeleteSpaceMember
observations.claim: The Connect handler delegates to APIV1Service.DeleteSpaceMember, whose visible implementation obtains the current user, resolves the requested member resource, applies the self-versus-different-target guard, and then invokes the store deletion operation.

observations.claim: When the selected target differs from the caller, the API invokes requireSpaceAdministrator(callerMembership) and returns the error before calling the store if that check fails.

observations.subject: targetMembership
observations.claim: After the API guard passes, the store delegates to the database driver, whose inspected MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQLite implementations delete the selected active membership after backend checks; they protect the last active normal administrator.

observations.subject: self versus different target
observations.claim: Self-removal bypasses the API administrator check. Different-member removal requires the API administrator check and, in the inspected database implementations, an active administrator actor; invalid resources, missing memberships, backend errors, and last-active-normal-admin protection can also prevent deletion.

observations.subject: DeleteSpaceMember
observations.claim: Administrator-removal and self-removal use the same API entry and then share the same store deletion call after a target-identity branch.

observations.subject: request.Name
observations.claim: The declared resource name has the form spaces/{space}/members/{username}; the resolved target membership determines the space and user identifiers deleted by both branches.

observations.subject: isSelf
observations.claim: The visible branch sets isSelf from targetUser.ID == currentUser.ID; self requests skip requireSpaceAdministrator, while non-self requests must pass it.

observations.subject: Store.DeleteSpaceMember
observations.claim: Both branches call Store.DeleteSpaceMember with targetMembership.SpaceID and targetMembership.UserID. The inspected SQL implementations delete the active membership after backend validation and commit the transaction on success.

observations.subject: database implementations
observations.claim: MySQL and PostgreSQL reject non-self actors whose user status is not normal and require an active administrator role; SQLite requires an active normal administrator for non-self deletion. All three inspected implementations protect removal of the last active normal administrator.

This conflicts with the supplied policy, which permits any current member to remove a different member.
